contracts_rationale: Bug-fix mission on commit scoping; no interface, endpoint or payload is added.
friendly_name: Schema-3 upgrade commits only what it changed
purpose_context: Upgrading a 2.x project runs a migration that commits with git add -A and retries with --no-verify, so untracked secrets, staged files and unrelated edits are committed at exit 0 and a hook that would have refused them is skipped. This mission routes the migration's changes through the upgrade command's existing commit, which only commits paths the upgrade changed and honours hooks.
purpose_tldr: Stop spec-kitty upgrade from sweeping a project's uncommitted work, including untracked secrets, into the schema-3 migration commit and from bypassing commit hooks (#5443).
